next_actions: Do not publish the 2026-09-29 handoff set as Nyx: recorded review finds human ears, a banded tail and hair/face drift. Treat it as off-model; re-generate through the contract flow if the stories still matter.
Make openai_image_provider.OUTPUT_SIZE and story_continuity's output width/height derive from the lock's aspect_ratio (9:16 -> 1080x1920, 4:5 -> 1080x1350). Code change, zero spend.
Instagram-bound locks are 9:16 but IG carousels max out at 4:5. Either re-lock IG stories to 4:5, or produce a 4:5 IG master plus a 9:16 TikTok/Fanvue master per slide.
carousel_handoff's single 7% overlay margin puts text inside the UI zones of every 9:16 surface. Read the margin per platform from qa_benchmark/platform_formats.json instead.
Until FMT-LOCK is fixed, any 9:16 slide sent to an IG carousel loses its overlay text to the crop.
star_map_001 and the_charm_001 share location_id nyx_apartment_bedroom with different anchors (window, trunk). Reconcile them or split the id. Founder call, text-only edit.
x_story_image is ~2:3 and gets centre-cropped on X; rebuild at 4:5 if X is ever connected.

identity_anchors.check: Same bone structure, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, hairline as gen_ref_1 / reference_primary CLOSE-UP.
Long, dark brown/near-black, centre-part hairline. Styling may vary; length class and colour may not.
Exactly 2 visible ears, both fox ears on top of head; 0 human ears (no earrings hanging from a visible human ear).
Exactly 1 bushy dark-brown tail, lighter tip; no banding/raccoon rings. Required when frame shows hips/full body.
Warm light skin, visible pores/texture, not smoothed.
One distinct mark, anatomical LEFT cheek (viewer-right on a front view), mid-cheek below outer eye corner. Not verifiable when that cheek is off-frame: record N/A, not PASS.
Clearly adult, mid-20s. Any teen/child coding is an automatic FAIL.
Photoreal, human-dominant, restrained fox traits; not anime/mascot.
Where wording and reference_primary disagree, the image wins.
